name: kage
tagline: An interactive five-chapter night walk through a Kyoto mountain temple, rendered live in Three.js
description: kage is an interactive five-chapter night walk through a Kyoto mountain temple, rendered live in Three.js. It is a generative-art and interactive-storytelling piece by Meng To (the creator of Design+Code and Stitch), combining WebGL, Japanese design aesthetics, and a narrative arc you navigate by walking. It is a showcase of what web-native interactive art can feel like.
highlights: Five-chapter narrative walk through a virtual Kyoto temple
Live Three.js/WebGL rendering, no video tricks
From Meng To, a well-known design educator
725 stars in days shows the appetite for web-native art
curatorNote: Most AI-era web art is still flat; kage is a proper interactive night-walk built in Three.js, and the design pedigree shows. Bookmark it as a benchmark for storytelling on the web.
